editorial.blurb: La Calle brings authentic, freshly made Mexican tacos and tequila to South Loop with genuinely warm service and vibrant artwork that makes every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Campechano tacos (chorizo mixed with steak) and don't skip the salsa with chips—reviewers rave it has a unique kick, and the beans are so good they've converted bean-haters into fans.
